question: Can typed operator programs and simultaneous inverse intertwiner synthesis generate and exactly check shared operator maps without supplying the desired map?
scope: Executable search infrastructure; known five-mode CAR recovery control and synthetic inverse control. No physical source selection.
summary_de: Neue automatische Operatorwortsuche mit gelernten Gegenbeispielen und inverse lineare/antilineare Abbildungssuche. 2048 Wort-/Typ-Klassen reproduzieren eine bekannte CAR-Abbildung; dies ist Werkzeugkalibrierung, keine neue physische Herleitung.
summary_en: New operator-word CEGIS and inverse simultaneous linear/antilinear intertwiner synthesis. 2048 word/type classes recover a known CAR map; this calibrates tools, not physical origin.
assumptions: Given finite charged CAR representation for the recovery control
Declared operator pairs and star closure for the inverse solver
Finite dimensions; physical interpretation must be established separately
positive_results: Candidate structures and linearity types are generated, not seeded with the target map
Exact counterexamples update constraints and invalidate stale evaluations
Twelve generic operator-transport theorems checked by Lean; specific matrix candidates checked separately
leaves_open: Synthesis of the original full positive source kernel
Source-derived carrier marking, physical state, time and event law
Automatic free noncommutative polynomial and continuum search
firewall: experiments; search tooling only; no ledger/paper/verification promotion
